offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures school buses and related parts for school districts and private fleet operators. Sells mainly through independent dealers and direct sales, and also offers aftermarket parts and service for its buses.

primary_products.value: school buses; propane buses; electric buses; replacement parts

primary_services.value: parts distribution; bus service and repair; fleet support

customer_segment.value: B2G: public school districts; B2B: private school operators, bus contractors, commercial fleet operators

end_markets.value: K-12 education transportation; commercial fleet transportation

revenue_model.value: product sales: school buses sold to districts and fleet operators; service fees: replacement parts, repair and aftermarket support

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds buses from purchased chassis and components, sold to dealers and districts; distributor: sells and distributes parts through a dealer network

geography_served.value: North America: United States, with sales and dealers in Canada and some other international markets

specialization.value: niche specialist: school buses of several types, alternative-fuel buses, and related parts

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: independent school bus dealers; direct sales: direct sales to large school districts and national fleet accounts

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: federal motor vehicle safety standards and EPA emissions rules for school buses

notes: Customer and channel details are based on general knowledge of the company and may not be fully current.
